from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single legal document relevant to the task."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The title of the legal document")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action or case category stated in the document text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregate extracted information from the document."""
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
